blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No one won the jackpots in the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Mega Lotto 6/45 draws on Monday, Sept. 28. This was according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). No bettor picked the Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 48-15-44-37-34-33 for a jackpot of ₱230.98 million. The Mega Lotto 6/45 winning combination was 21-14-19-38-40-02 for a jackpot of ₱79.28 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
